codex.format: Recursive config-folder/agents/**/*.toml. name, description, developer_instructions required. Explicit config.toml role/config_file remains visible read-only.

claude_code.format: User/project agents recursive YAML markdown. Managed directory .claude/agents. Prompt body; name/description/tools/model/permissionMode. Documentation inspected on checkedAt; actual --help agents is runtime sessions, not definition list.

grok.format: Installed executable embedded Agent Profiles reference confirms YAML Markdown under .grok/agents and GROK_HOME/agents. inspect --json verified actual enabled fixture then absence after moving outside agents; exit 0 both, no inference. A nested agents/subdir fixture was not discovered by native inspect; Grok scanning is intentionally shallow.

open_code.format: agent/agents/**/*.md follows JSON agent config merge. --pure agent list found isolated fixture; moving outside agents removed it; exit 0 both, no inference.
